Image alt: This bar chart is titled “Average U.S. Income, 2015.” The y-axis is labeled “Income” and starts at 0 dollars and increases by 1,000,000 dollars up to 8,000,000 dollars. The x-axis is labeled “Earners” and shows income for earners in the bottom 90 percent, top 10 percent, top 5 percent, top 1 percent, and top 0.1 percent. The bar for bottom 90 percent is barely visible. The bar for top 10 percent is up to about 300,000. The bar for top 5 percent is up to about 500,000. The bar for top 1 percent is up to about 1,400,000. The bar for top 0.1 percent is up to about 6,800,0000.
